newsitem.title: POLAND: IB AUSTRIA DOWGRADES BFK TO REDUCE.
newsitem.headline: IB AUSTRIA DOWGRADES BFK TO REDUCE.

text.p: Investmentbank Austria downgraded Polish cable maker Bydgoska Fabryka Kabli SA to "reduce" from long term "buy" in a report dated March 20.

It said that even though BFK's products were technologically advanced and sold at high margins the growing competition in the sector, especially abroad, would make the firm's increasing earnings difficult to sustain.
"These factors, combined with the current valuation, lead us to downgrade our rating from long term buy to reduce," the report said.
"Compared to the European average, the shares are already quite pricely...," it added. On March 20, BFK, in which trader Elektrim holds a 53-percent stake, traded at 22 zlotys a share.
IB Austria said it expected BFK's pace of earnings growth to slow down to 18 percent this year and seven percent in 1998 in real terms.
